scope: Repository curriculum design, learner workflow, and locally verifiable quality contracts
boundary: A score of 100 means every criterion in this repository-quality rubric has an implemented and checked contract. It is not a universal ranking, a promise that every learner becomes an expert, a hardware certificate, or a claim of state-of-the-art model performance.

criteria.name: Beginner onboarding and diagnosis
criteria.gap: No single first-hour route or evidence-based self-diagnostic.

criteria.name: Dependency-ordered curriculum structure
criteria.gap: Already strong; preserve complete coverage of the knowledge graph.

criteria.name: Embodied AI conceptual coverage
criteria.gap: Already covers mathematics, robotics, learning, planning, tasks, and deployment evidence.

criteria.name: Runnable practice and engineering progression
criteria.name_zh: 可运行实践与工程进阶
criteria.gap: Runnable pipelines existed but were not bound into one learner progression with exit artifacts.

criteria.name: Mastery assessment and promotion gates
criteria.gap: Lesson checks existed, but there was no repository-wide scoring, critical-fail policy, or review workflow.

criteria.name: Portfolio and capstone system
criteria.gap: Research routes named deliverables but did not define staged capstones, scoring, or independent review.

criteria.name: Research literacy and experiment design
criteria.gap: Already strong; preserve matched baselines, ablations, uncertainty, and negative results.

criteria.name: Systems, safety, and Sim-to-Real boundaries
criteria.name_zh: 系统、安全与 Sim-to-Real 边界
criteria.gap: Already strong; keep hardware authorization separate from simulation evidence.

criteria.name: Evidence integrity and reproducibility
criteria.name_zh: 证据完整性与可复现性
criteria.gap: Already strong; extend evidence rules to learner progress and graduation.

criteria.name: Navigation, role accessibility, and bilingual core
criteria.name_zh: 导航、背景适配与双语核心
criteria.gap: Strong bilingual navigation, but no background-aware entry guidance or bilingual learner operating manual.
